# Parish Educational Consulting, LLC

> Educational consulting firm that partners with K-12 school districts to improve
> instruction, develop leaders, and raise student achievement. Founded and led by
> Dr. Veronica Williams Parish, a former school principal, district leader, and
> assistant professor. Based in Mississippi, serving the surrounding region, with
> national engagements by arrangement.

## Key facts

- Founder and lead consultant: Dr. Veronica Williams Parish (former principal,
  district leader, assistant professor; expertise across K-12, higher education,
  and correctional education systems)
- Signature method: the 3-Phase Impact Model. Assess (analyze school data,
  instructional practices, and organizational systems), Align (develop targeted
  strategic plans tailored to district goals), Accelerate (implement responsive
  solutions with ongoing executive coaching and staff support)
- Documented outcome areas from Dr. Parish's leadership record: increased student
  and staff attendance, elevated teacher morale, stronger parent and community
  engagement, significant reduction in discipline incidents and out-of-school
  suspensions
- Tagline: Transforming Schools. Empowering Leaders. Elevating Student Success.

## Books by Dr. Veronica Williams Parish

All five are available on Amazon in Kindle and/or paperback editions.

1. Knowing My History: For Black Youths (ages 8 to 13). The legacy of Black
   excellence from ancient African kingdoms to modern innovators, with reflection
   questions, a youth glossary, and a teacher and parent guide.
   https://www.amazon.com/Knowing-My-History-Black-Youths-ebook/dp/B0HF9RPHYW/
2. Knowing My History (ages 12 to 18). Illustrated profiles of Black pioneers in
   medicine, education, science, and literature.
   https://www.amazon.com/Knowing-History-Dr-Veronica-Parish-ebook/dp/B0FFR1BLLL/
3. Black Man, Black Man, Where Are You? A story of generational trauma, fatherhood,
   incarceration, and redemption.
   https://www.amazon.com/Black-Man-Where-Are-You/dp/B0H443SYYN/
4. Oh, How I look Up to my Dad! A picture book about a son who admires his father.
   https://www.amazon.com/Oh-How-look-Up-Dad-ebook/dp/B0DDR8FXDS/
5. Grandpa Curtis Lets Me Do Whatever I Want! A summer in Mississippi and the bond
   between a grandfather and grandson.
   https://www.amazon.com/Grandpa-Curtis-Lets-Whatever-Want-ebook/dp/B0CW5WKWW3/

## Services

1. Instructional Leadership and School Improvement: school improvement planning,
   instructional coaching, ELA and Math curriculum alignment, Science of Reading
   implementation, classroom observation and feedback systems
2. Leadership Development: principal and assistant principal coaching, teacher
   leadership pipelines, PLCs, culturally responsive leadership
3. Student Achievement and Intervention: strategies for struggling learners,
   literacy and numeracy acceleration, MTSS/RTI support, closing achievement gaps
4. School Culture and Climate: safe and supportive environments, behavior and
   discipline systems, restorative practices, SEL integration, staff morale
5. Alternative and Nontraditional Education: dropout prevention, credit recovery,
   re-engagement systems, correctional and alternative education consulting

## Published pricing (scoped to the district; ranges reflect scope and travel)

- Walkthrough + Debrief Package: $500 to $700 per visit
- Professional Development: Half-Day $700 to $800, Full-Day $850 to $1,000 per session
- Professional Development Series: $2,500 to $5,000 per series
- Leadership Coaching: $1,500 to $2,500 per month, per leader (3 to 6 month cycles)
- School Improvement Partnership (6 to 12 months): $2,500 to $4,500 per month
